definitions.short: mighty ; abstractly, permission ; concretely, a premier
definitions.full: H7990. shallit שַׁלִּיט adjective having mastery, ruling ; — absolute ׳שׁ Ezra 7:24 +, emphatic אָ֯ Dan 2:15 ; masculine plural שְׁלִיטִין Ezra 4:20 , מִן - Dan 4:23 ; — 1 having, exercising, mastery: a. of God, followed by ב , Dan 4:14 ; 4:22 ; 4:29 ; 5:21 ; absolute, of heavens 4:23 b. of kings Ezra 4:20 ( ב ). 2 as noun = ruler Dan 2:10 , captain 2:15 . 3 having authority to do a thing (Infinitive), hence impersonal = it is authorized , Ezra 7:24 (so often in Syriac; compare S-C A 11 + למבנה שליט אנת ).
